facts.business: TAJ GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited operates luxury hotels and resorts in India.
key_risks: Economic Risks: Hotel business sensitive to fluctuations in economy, global recession, excess room supply, reduced demand, competition, government policies, interest rates, foreign exchange rates, natural and social factors.

Socio-Political Risks: Volatile socio-political environment, political instability, conflict between nations, terrorist attacks, spread of epidemic, security threats affecting travel and business activity.
Security Risks: Terrorism and political instability in South East Asia, need for international standards of safety.

Business interruption risk on account of unprecedented events like a pandemic: Severe downturn in all streams of business, lockdowns, travel restrictions, fear of pandemic spread, hygiene standards and pandemic protocols.
Risk of wage inflation: Quality employees demand, wage inflation critical factor in determining costs.
Foreign Exchange Risk: Fluctuation of Indian Rupee against other foreign currencies, mitigated by single currency billing in Indian Rupees.
Project Implementation Risk: Delays in implementation of projects increasing project cost and loss of potential revenue.
